title: Why the Dorset people of the Arctic vanished
summary: The Dorset were extinct by 1500 at the latest, perhaps by 1000. Why they vanished is unclear, and there is almost no evidence of contact with the incoming Thule.
why: A whole Arctic people disappeared as the Thule spread through their lands.
question: Why did the Dorset culture of the Arctic disappear?
evidence: Radiocarbon dates at Cambridge Bay to about 1350 CE; Medieval Warm Period sea-ice loss would have hit them; virtually no genetic or cultural interaction with Thule.
wouldSettle: Well-dated last Dorset sites set against sea-ice records, Thule arrival dates and ancient DNA.

theories.name: Loss of sea ice
theories.idea: Medieval Warm Period melting reduced the sea ice they relied on.

theories.name: New diseases
theories.idea: They were vulnerable to newly introduced diseases.

theories.name: Thule replacement
theories.idea: The incoming Thule took over their lands, though direct conflict is unproven.
